image.name: nzbhydra2
image.description: [Nzbhydra2](https://github.com/theotherp/nzbhydra2) is a meta search application for NZB indexers, the spiritual successor to NZBmegasearcH, and an evolution of the original application [NZBHydra](https://github.com/theotherp/nzbhydra).  It provides easy access to a number of raw and newznab based indexers.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Ubuntu Noble. Remove standalone JRE ([#46](https://github.com/linuxserver/docker-nzbhydra2/pull/46)).
Update release URL for arch-specific packages.
Bump master JRE to v17. Default mapIpToHost to false.
Reorganize container, Relocate app to /app/nzbhydra2/bin, Create /app/nzbhydra2/package_info, Use nzbhydra2wrapperPy3.py from zip.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Add pipeline logic and multi arch.
Bump java version to 10, (bionic currently refers to it as version 11).
Change to port 5076 in the Dockerfile.

volumes.desc: Where nzbhydra2 should store config data.

image.title: Nzbhydra2
image.setup_instructions: The web interface is at `<your ip>:5076` , to set up indexers and connections to your nzb download applications.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  nzbhydra2:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/nzbhydra2:latest
    container_name: nzbhydra2
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/nzbhydra2/data:/config
      - /path/to/downloads:/downloads #optional
    ports:
      - 5076:5076
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=nzbhydra2 \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 5076:5076 \
  -v /path/to/nzbhydra2/data:/config \
  -v /path/to/downloads:/downloads `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/nzbhydra2:latest
